stubs.how: MAPTILER_MAP_STYLE_LIGHT/DARK build env vars (the app's own config) point at local MapLibre style JSONs in .ui-capture/maptiler-stub/, rendering Natural Earth country polygons (world-atlas npm package, generated by .ui-capture/tools/make-map-stub.cjs) from GeoJSON; glyph requests get an empty PBF. Served by Caddy at /maptiler-stub/*.

stubs.service: MapTiler geocoding API (location search in activity/accommodation forms, region centering on the trip map)
stubs.how: A build-only pre-entry (.ui-capture/maptiler-offline.ts, added via .ui-capture/rsbuild.capture.config.ts; no repo source changed) sets the MapTiler SDK's config.fetch to rewrite https://api.maptiler.com/* to /maptiler-stub/api/*, handled by .ui-capture/maptiler-stub/api.php, which returns MapTiler-format FeatureCollections searched over country bboxes plus all places saved in the database.
Disabled in the same pre-entry (config.telemetry = false, config.session = false); /maptiler-stub/api/metrics answers 204 if ever called.
Placeholder MAPTILER_API_KEY=local-placeholder-key in the root .env (required by rsbuild.config.ts).
GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/SECRET left empty in backend/.env, so /api/auth/google reports enabled:false and the app hides the button; sign in with the local email/password account instead.
SENTRY_ENABLED=false and GOATCOUNTER_HOSTNAME empty at build time (the app's own switches).
Laravel MAIL_MAILER=log (backend .env default); messages go to backend/storage/logs.
Laravel backend uses SQLite at backend/database/database.sqlite (DB_CONNECTION=sqlite), migrated with the repo's migrations.

notes: Setup: mise.toml pins node 24.22.3, pnpm 10.15.1 and FrankenPHP 1.13.5 (static PHP 8.5 + Caddy, from GitHub releases; attestation checks are off because sigstore is unreachable). Front end: pnpm install, then a production rsbuild build via .ui-capture/rsbuild.capture.config.ts (repo config + MapTiler offline pre-entry) into .ui-capture/web. Back end: the repo's Laravel 13 JSON API (backend/), composer deps installed from composer.lock by .ui-capture/composer-install.sh (composer.phar from GitHub; dist URLs temporarily rewritten from api.github.com to codeload.github.com, lockfile restored afterwards), backend/.env from .env.example with SQLite, APP_KEY generated, migrations run. start.sh re-runs the seed (~2s), then runs FrankenPHP with .ui-capture/Caddyfile on $PORT: /api/* and /up go to Laravel (backend/public), /maptiler-stub/* goes to the map/geocoding stub, and everything else is the SPA with index.html fallback. Data: .ui-capture/seed/seed.php (+ lib.php, trips_japan.php, trips_more.php) writes through Laravel's DB layer into the app's schema: 11 users and 14 trips (163 activities incl. flights/trains/ideas, 14 stays, 23 day-range plans, 79 expenses in local and home currencies with SGD conversions, 10 task lists / 44 tasks in mixed states, 10 comment threads, some resolved). The signed-in user priya_raman (Singapore, SGD) has: an in-progress Japan trip (10–22 Nov 2026, today = day 7 in Kyoto) shared with 3 others; upcoming Seoul (NYE), Taipei (CNY) and a draft Iceland trip; past Bali, Lisbon & Porto (public), KL and Penang; trips others shared with her (Bangkok offsite as editor, Penang wedding and Hana's Tokyo picks as viewer); 2 archived trips (Hanoi, Melbourne). Two public trips from other users appear under Public trips. Other demo users share the same password (e.g. marcus.tan@example.com). Main areas: /trip (trip list: upcoming/ongoing/past, archived at /trip/archived, public at /trip/public), and inside a trip /trip/:id/home, /timetable, /list, /map, /expense, /task, /comment, plus /account/edit. Log in at /login (email lookup first, then password). Couldn't screenshot-check the UI here because the sandbox blocks headless Electron; checked over HTTP instead (login, trips list by status, trip detail, sync, stubs).
